en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground is a fenced dirt field leading up to a traditional wooden house with two chimneys and shuttered windows. A smaller outbuilding stands nearer to the water behind the main house. Hills or low mountains rise on the far side of the lake. Printed text appears at the top, identifying the location as a country store.
